articles.summary: Armstrong World Industries Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Armstrong World Industries, Inc. (AWI), today announced its 2026 Better Building Grant recipients, awarding more than $600,000 to 10 nonprofit organizations to support building renovations, facility improvements and essential community services. Leaders from Armstrong World Industries, including CEO Mark Hershey, present a check on behalf of the Armstrong World Industries Foundation to Community Action Partnership of Lancaster County, an organization dedicated to helping families achieve economic mobility and stability, during the inaugural Armstrong World Industries Community Impact Celebration. articles.title: Armstrong World Industries Foundation Awards More Than $600,000 in 2026 Better Building Grants
